findings.claim: device_notes asserts hevel and tachat-hashemesh both begin once the monologue proper opens, but both devices demonstrably begin inside the frame's own prologue poem, one to two verses before the monologue (parent_collection M) opens at oshb:Eccl.1.12.
findings.evidence: skeleton-tier sweep for the hevel-family consonantal form (sweep.py --skel, verse-count mode) returns oshb:Eccl.1.2 as the first hevel-family verse; byte text at oshb:Eccl.1.2 (verse_map_oshb.json) is הֲבֵ֤ל הֲבָלִים֙ אָמַ֣ר קֹהֶ֔לֶת הֲבֵ֥ל הֲבָלִ֖ים הַכֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל -- the havel-havalim superlative doubled. Byte text at oshb:Eccl.1.3 is מַה יִּתְר֖וֹן לָֽאָדָ֑ם בְּכָל עֲמָל֔וֹ שֶֽׁיַּעֲמֹ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ and at oshb:Eccl.1.9 is מַה שֶּֽׁהָיָה֙ ה֣וּא שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֔ה וּמַה שֶׁנַּֽעֲשָׂ֔ה ה֖וּא שֶׁיֵּעָשֶׂ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין כָּל חָדָ֖שׁ תַּ֥חַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ, both carrying the tachat-hashemesh (under-the-sun) formula (matches the book strategy's tally of 3 ch-1 sites: 1:3, 1:9, 1:14). All three sites (1:2, 1:3, 1:9) sit inside this row's own parent_collection F1 Eccl.1.1-Eccl.1.11 (the prologue poem), before oshb:Eccl.1.12 where row P01-004's parent_collection (M Eccl.1.12-Eccl.12.7, the monologue) begins.

findings.claim: strongest_rejected_alternative calls Eccl.1.2 a quoted first-person-framed pronouncement introduced by its own said-formula, but 1:2 carries no first-person grammatical marker and is one of the book's three amar-qohelet THIRD-PERSON frame intrusions (1:2, 7:27, 12:8); this writer's own sibling row P03-027 correctly calls the identical construction at 12:8 a third-person frame intrusion outside the first-person monologue.
findings.evidence: oshb:Eccl.1.2 byte text (verse_map_oshb.json) is הֲבֵ֤ל הֲבָלִים֙ אָמַ֣ר קֹהֶ֔לֶת הֲבֵ֥ל הֲבָלִ֖ים הַכֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל -- containing the third-person said-formula (amar qohelet, 'said the Qohelet') and no first-person pronoun or verb form. eccl_device_inventory.json's amar-qohelet frame-intrusion list names exactly 1:2, 7:27, 12:8. Row P03-027 (decision_id P03-027, strongest_rejected_alternative) independently describes the 12:8 instance of the same amar-qohelet construction as opening a 'fresh third-person frame intrusion ("said the Qohelet") outside the first-person monologue' -- the two rows characterize the same device class incompatibly.

findings.claim: boundary_rationale's closing clause ('the discourse turns to a first-person retrospective in the verse that follows') alludes to oshb:Eccl.9.11 without ever naming it by ref or verse number, and boundary_evidence_refs lists only the 9:10 setumah citation -- unlike sibling rows (e.g. P01-004, P01-018) that verse-anchor an identical kind of forward-reference claim.
findings.evidence: row P03-003 boundary_evidence_refs = ["oshb:Eccl.9.10 (setumah, single-witness)"] only; the shavti+raiti register-shift verse oshb:Eccl.9.11, byte text שַׁ֜בְתִּי וְרָאֹ֣ה תַֽחַת הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֣י לֹא֩ לַקַּלִּ֨ים הַמֵּר֜וֹץ וְלֹ֧א לַגִּבּוֹרִ֣ים הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְ֠גַם לֹ֣א לַחֲכָמִ֥ים לֶ֨חֶם֙ וְגַ֨ם לֹ֤א לַנְּבֹנִים֙ עֹ֔שֶׁר וְגַ֛ם לֹ֥א לַיֹּדְעִ֖ים חֵ֑ן כִּי עֵ֥ת וָפֶ֖גַע יִקְרֶ֥ה אֶת כֻּלָּֽם, is the unnamed basis for the row's own right-edge close but is cited nowhere by ref or digit. Compare row P01-018, which names and discloses web:Eccl.4.4 as its own forward-pointer neighbor in both prose and boundary_evidence_refs.

findings.claim: boundary_evidence_refs cites web:Eccl.10.16-Eccl.10.17 for the rejected 'preceding woe/blessed royal oracle' reading, but the prose never verse-anchors this citation anywhere (no '10:16', '10:17', or 'vv.16-17' token appears) -- the shared validator's own refs_mirror pass flags this exact row as its single orphan_ref_warn in the corpus.
findings.evidence: rows_v2.jsonl.validator_report.json refs_mirror.orphan_ref_warns[0]: decision_id P03-021, orphan_refs web:Eccl.10.16-Eccl.10.17; row's strongest_rejected_alternative only says 'the preceding woe/blessed royal oracle,' never anchoring to a verse number. Independently re-verified the underlying claim: oshb:Eccl.10.19 byte text לִשְׂחוֹק֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים לֶ֔חֶם וְיַ֖יִן יְשַׂמַּ֣ח חַיִּ֑ים וְהַכֶּ֖סֶף יַעֲנֶ֥ה אֶת הַכֹּֽל shares no repeated root with oshb:Eccl.10.17 byte text אַשְׁרֵ֣יךְ אֶ֔רֶץ שֶׁמַּלְכֵּ֖ךְ בֶּן חוֹרִ֑ים וְשָׂרַ֨יִךְ֙ בָּעֵ֣ת יֹאכֵ֔לוּ בִּגְבוּרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א בַשְּׁתִֽי, so the boundary conclusion itself holds -- only the citation is unanchored.
